name: Vann-Ly
message:
Try everything at least once!!!  

My husband has heard me for years talk about the fish balls and they did not disappoint. He loved them. They are so good. Even in patty form! We highly recommend. 

The food was packaged beautifully and pick up was easy. We enjoyed the lamprais very much. The sides you get with your rice are so yummy. Please support this amazing family venture. Love you guys!

name: Nalin Dissanayake
message: I highly recommend Loku’s Catering. The food was delicious, fresh, and full of flavor. The catering service offered excellent value for money, with generous portions and great quality. The staff were friendly, professional, and attentive to our guests throughout the event. Everything was delivered and set up on time, making the experience stress-free and enjoyable. If you are looking for tasty food, reliable service, and a team that truly cares about customer satisfaction, Loku’s Catering is an excellent choice.
